# Which upstream release this fork's source layer is derived from.
#
# NOT the same thing as XC_VM_VERSION in Core/Config/AppConfig.php. That is
# this fork's own number and deliberately runs ahead, so the panel's updater
# has something to offer. This file answers a different question: whose
# deploy tree do we overlay our source onto, and which upstream tag do the
# release notes credit. It changes only when the fork actually merges a
# newer upstream release -- which is exactly what watch-upstream.yml opens
# an issue about.
#
# Keeping the two apart is not pedantry. Upstream's 2.4.x and 2.5.x tags
# exist but are prereleases of an unreleased line, so asking upstream for
# "our" 2.4.0 succeeds and hands back a tree this fork's source was never
# built against -- and the watcher, which uses this as a git ref inside
# upstream's repository, would have compared from the wrong point.
#
# One bare version, first non-comment line.
2.3.9
